messages:
zoe: spotted uptick in soft fncall schema fixes on route 'payments-main' — runtime coerced and routed to fallback-quant, increased tail latency for a customer.
marco: sample payload we logged:
```json
{"tool":"pay/charge","args":{"amount_cents":"1250","currency": "USD"},"meta":{"route_id":"payments-main-eu"}}
```
elijah: currency typed as string vs enum; runtime coerced amount to int and executed on fallback. we need explicit telemetry for these soft fixes so support + billing can trace.
priya: proposal: emit flat event `fncall_schema_signal` with keys: severity, kind (soft_fix), route_id, exec_variant, coercions (list), billed_route, charged_on_exec ("true"/"false"), sampled_span.
marco: example:
```json
{"event":"fncall_schema_signal","severity":"warning","kind":"soft_fix","route_id":"payments-main-eu","exec_variant":"fallback-quant-2x","coercions": ["args.amount_cents:str->int"],"billed_route":"payments-main-eu","charged_on_exec":"true","sampled_span":"span-998","ts":"2026-03-20T14:22:10Z"}
```
zoe: sampling rules: always capture first 4 signals per route/hr, then 1% random. push to kafka topic `telemetry.fncall_signals.v1` retention 30d -> materialized table for Console.
elijah: Console: show amber pill "Schema signals: 9 (24h)" on route page; details show sampled events and quick "open billing ticket" with attached event.
priya: add metric counter `fncall.schema_signals.soft_fix` with tags route_id, exec_variant, region. rollout 1% -> 5% -> 25% with stop criteria: signals >4% or billing delta >10%.
notif-bot: deploy queued: feature/fncall-signals -> staging, CI 6/6 passed.
marco: I'll draft telemetry PR with event schema and kafka config. priya: I'll mock Console panel by EOD.
